title: Chapter 311 Acting County Magistrate
content:
Chapter 311 Acting County Magistrate

"I hope you can integrate the forces of Changping County as soon as possible, and then support Hedong County. Are you willing?"

Wang Shuo was a little confused.

"Why me?"

Although Wang Shuo was the first in Changping County, he was among the lord players. As a small town in the Changping County system, there were many mayors whose strength was not inferior to Wang Shuo.

Xie Xiaofeng smiled mysteriously: "Because it was Zhao Junshou who personally instructed! Even if Lin Xiaodong was still alive, the Changping County coalition forces that went to support were led by you."

After that, Xie Xiaofeng turned and walked towards the teleportation array.

Wang Shuo was shocked. The Hedong Junshou thought so highly of him. You know, as the commander of the coalition forces, he was very important. One of his decisions might affect the lives of tens of thousands of people.

Even so, Wang Shuo was still very happy to accept it!

After all, he was the acting county magistrate.

"Mayors and lords, do you have any objections to Xie Xiaofeng's proposal just now?"

At this time, several sharp-eyed mayors immediately echoed: "See County Magistrate Wang, with you leading us, we will be invincible and unstoppable."

The main people present were powerful mayors such as Bu Lanlan and Zheng Zhongji, and their support was particularly critical.

"Mayor Wang has good command and is brave in battle. He is naturally qualified to be the acting county magistrate. I have no objection." Bu Lanlan said slowly.

"County Magistrate Wang." Zheng Zhongji also bowed his hands, which was regarded as acknowledging his status.

So far, everyone has recognized Wang Shuo as the acting county magistrate.

Under the current situation, it is not so easy to be a county magistrate.

Wang Shuo immediately arranged personnel to restore order in the city and integrate everyone's troops.

After all, there are still three undead troops outside that have not been eliminated.

There are more than 1,000 troops left in Changping County. Wang Shuo selected another 20,000 people and began to reinforce the southern pass.

The catapult is a magical weapon for attacking cities and plundering land.

In the evening, the three passes were finally opened.

In the Changping County Lord's Mansion, which had been slightly renovated.

Many lords gathered.

Those present were all well-known and powerful lords in Changping County.

Wang Shuo told everyone that Lin Xiaodong had died in battle and that he would take over as the acting county magistrate.

The lords who came later were suddenly in an uproar.

Under the instigation of some people with ulterior motives, some lords finally stood up.

"Why should you be the acting county magistrate? I think there are many people who can take on this position!"

"Bullshit, our leader led the troops in this battle and made great contributions. Why can't he be the acting county magistrate? This is also what Hedong County wants."

"Haha, what's Hedong County? He is so powerful, does he still need us to rescue him?"

"I think you killed the weakling Lin County Magistrate yourself and want to replace him!"

These later lords did not experience fighting with undead beasts and bloodthirsty demon wolves.

Some of them don't know the height of the world.

"Insolent."

Wang Shuo would never allow anyone to talk about Lin Xiaodong's death.

Heroes are not allowed to be blasphemed!

Looking at all his actions, they are all fair and aboveboard. Although he has not made any major achievements, he is also well-behaved.

Wang Shuo gradually lost his patience.

"You all don't take Hedong County seriously at all."

Wang Shuo asked loudly.

Originally, Wang Shuo did not pay too much attention to the system town.

But Xie Xiaofeng's appearance completely overturned his cognition.

The strength of Hedong County is definitely not as simple as it seems on the surface.

Similarly, what I saw this time with the undead army is probably just the tip of the iceberg.

Apart from anything else, if there are a few general-level skeletons, the strength of Wana Town alone will not be able to stop them, so we still have to unite these forces that can be united.
